info.title: Archibase
info.description: Machine-readable architectural floor plans (room adjacency graphs and vector geometry), paid per request with x402 in USDC.
info.x-guidance: Archibase sells structured architectural floor plans for spatial AI and design agents. Call GET /api/v1/plans/search to find plans by bedrooms, area (m2_min/m2_max or sqft_min/sqft_max), style, building_type, built, source; it returns up to 100 records, each with a room adjacency graph (rooms with type, area, window count; door/opening edges), provenance, and vector_schema_url. Call GET /api/v1/plans/{plan_id}/vector with a plan_id from search to get room polygons, doors and windows in metres (units=imperial for feet), only when vector_schema_url is not null. Use search first; fetch geometry only for plans you need. Both calls are paid per request in USDC via x402 (search 0.02, vector price in x-payment-info): an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header listing accepts[] (network, asset, payTo, amount); sign and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Invalid queries return 400 before any charge. Free: GET /api/v1/count (match counts) and GET /api/v1/sample (sample data), useful to tune filters before paying. Output is JSON. Prefer metric units unless the user needs sqft.

get.description: Search architectural floor plans. Returns structured JSON records with room adjacency graphs and links to vector (geometry) schemas.

parameters.name: m2_min
parameters.description: Minimum net interior area in m² (inclusive)

schema.description: Minimum net interior area in m² (inclusive)

parameters.name: m2_max
parameters.description: Maximum net interior area in m² (inclusive)

schema.description: Maximum net interior area in m² (inclusive)

parameters.name: sqft_min
parameters.description: Same filter in square feet (converted to m²; don't combine with m2_*)

schema.description: Same filter in square feet (converted to m²; don't combine with m2_*)

parameters.name: sqft_max
parameters.description: Same filter in square feet (converted to m²; don't combine with m2_*)

schema.description: Same filter in square feet (converted to m²; don't combine with m2_*)

parameters.name: built
parameters.description: true = plans of constructed buildings only; false = unbuilt designs only

schema.description: true = plans of constructed buildings only; false = unbuilt designs only

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Provenance: synthetic, habs, commissioned, dataset, ai_generated

schema.description: Provenance: synthetic, habs, commissioned, dataset, ai_generated

parameters.name: building_type
parameters.description: What the building is used for, e.g. residential, office, retail, transport. Non-residential plans are one floor each

schema.description: What the building is used for, e.g. residential, office, retail, transport. Non-residential plans are one floor each

parameters.name: include_duplicates
parameters.description: Datasets repeat the same apartment on many floors. Default false returns one plan per layout (see layout_copies); true returns every copy

schema.description: Datasets repeat the same apartment on many floors. Default false returns one plan per layout (see layout_copies); true returns every copy

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: Response units. metric (default): total_area_m2 and room areas in m². imperial: total_sqft and room areas in sqft.

schema.description: Response units. metric (default): total_area_m2 and room areas in m². imperial: total_sqft and room areas in sqft.

building_type.description: What the building is used for. Absent = residential

total_area_m2.description: Net interior area in m² (metric responses)

total_sqft.description: Net interior area in sqft (units=imperial responses)

bedrooms.description: Labelled bedrooms plus rooms inferred as bedrooms

bedrooms_inferred.description: How many of bedrooms are inferred (rooms the source didn't label; see node inferred_use). Absent = 0

adjacency_graph.description: Rooms as nodes, connections (door/opening/...) as undirected edges

type.description: Room type from the source. "room" = a private room the source did not label

windows.description: Number of windows in this room, when known

stairwell.description: true when this space is a stairwell opening rather than floor: it has no area and is excluded from total_area_m2

inferred_use.description: Only on type "room": our inference, from windows, size and connections

layout_copies.description: How many plans in the catalogue share this exact layout (rooms, sizes, connections), this one included. 1 = unique

vector_schema_url.description: Paid URL for this plan's vector geometry (see the vector resource); null when none exists

provenance.description: Where the plan came from and the licence it is sold under

built.description: Whether the design was actually constructed

attribution.description: Credit line you must reproduce when the licence requires it

402.description: Payment required (x402). PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and JSON body carry accepts[].

get.summary: Get vector geometry for one plan
get.description: Vector geometry for one floor plan: room polygons (ids match the adjacency graph), doors and windows, in metres (or feet with units=imperial).

parameters.name: plan_id
parameters.description: A plan_id from search results (use when vector_schema_url is not null)

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: metric (default): coordinates in metres; imperial: feet

schema.description: metric (default): coordinates in metres; imperial: feet

attribution.description: Licence credit you must reproduce (e.g. CC BY)

polygon.description: Polygons; each is [outer ring, ...holes]; each ring is [[x, y], ...] closed
Polygons; each is [outer ring, ...holes]; each ring is [[x, y], ...] closed
Polygons; each is [outer ring, ...holes]; each ring is [[x, y], ...] closed

stairs.description: Internal stairs, on each level they appear: the flight where they start, the stairwell opening where they arrive

to_level.description: Set where the stair starts: the level it climbs to (footprint counts as floor area)

from_level.description: Set where the stair arrives: the level it comes from (polygon = stairwell opening, excluded from the room's area)

room.description: Graph node id of the room the stair stands in

start.description: Bottom of the flight [x, y]; with end, gives the direction up

run.description: Horizontal length of the flight (file units)

polygon.description: The stair zone; individual treads are not modelled

402.description: Payment required (x402). PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and JSON body carry accepts[].

404.description: Unknown plan or no geometry (not charged)
